threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You can tell a newbie by their bewilderment at the London Fields lido's freezing water – all the locals know that's just how it is!
Saw a guy on the 196 bus playing the ukulele at 2 AM. Everyone looked annoyed, but he kept strumming like it was a concert. Strange vibe in Brixton tonight.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: Hearing those late-night kebab shop arguments echoing off the walls while the train rumbles by felt like a rite of passage.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: You know it’s Berlin when your bus is delayed because a rave just wrapped up in the middle of the street. Only here does street art and nightlife merge so seamlessly.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can spot a local by their instinct to dodge the BART delays; tourists just stare at their phones, clueless, when the Civic Center station is shut down.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy in a tuxedo try to board the 27 with a pizza box. Muni just stopped, like it was the most normal thing in the world. Classic SF moment.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think the plaza is just for selfies, but it’s where we catch up with friends and hear local bands play on the weekends.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a recent arrival by their over-eager use of 'gràcies' every time they get change, even if it's just a coin.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still call it a ‘supermarket’ instead of the much cooler ‘local shop’. You’re definitely not from these parts.
Last night on the 45, heard a guy singing to himself while holding a half-eaten patty. Only in Brixton do midnight snacks come with live music.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The day I saw a pigeon strutting confidently in front of a café, completely ignoring the hipsters inside, was when I knew I was one of them.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: You ever notice how the S-Bahn rides are punctuated by impromptu accordion players? It's like a live soundtrack to your commute, adds a twist to the daily grind.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know someone’s a local if they can name the last time BART had a meltdown and still give you solid gossip about the latest taco truck opening.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy in a tuxedo looking like he just left a wedding, trying to impress a pigeon on the corner of Turk and Jones. Classic SF vibe.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: They think all the locals are friendly, but most of us just nod and keep walking. It's a head-down culture here, not a smile-fest.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell by their overzealous snapping of photos at every corner; the locals just glance and walk by the same murals.
